mode.title: Mode
mode.description: props = one row per player per market. players = one row per player listing every stat priced on them. markets = the non player depth on the same games, such as game props, alternate lines and correct score.
enumTitles: Player props (one row per player per market)

leaguePaths.title: League paths
leaguePaths.description: Which league to open games in. Examples: baseball/mlb, football/nfl, basketball/nba, soccer/north-america/united-states/mls, tennis. Books load player markets close to game time, so a league playing today returns far more than one out of season.

books.title: Books to read
books.description: Which sportsbooks to read props from. The two rarely price the same players: Bovada loads player markets as a game approaches, and Pinnacle files each prop as its own market, so reading both gives the wider board. Pinnacle covers the major leagues only.

players.title: Players (optional)
players.description: Partial names work. Empty returns every player the book prices on the games opened.

statContains.title: Stat contains (optional)
statContains.description: Match on the stat name, for example strikeouts, hits, goal, assist, rebounds. Empty returns every stat.

maxEvents.title: Games to open
maxEvents.description: Each game costs one extra request, and the soonest games are opened first because that is where the player markets are.

includeSuspended.title: Include suspended markets
includeSuspended.description: Off by default. A suspended market keeps its last price even though no bet can be taken on it.

maxRows.title: Maximum rows
maxRows.description: The first 2 rows of every run are free.
